description: This file contains code for fetching GitHub sponsorship data via GraphQL, processing sponsor information, updating a YAML file with sponsor data, and automating Git operations to create a pull request for updates.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor entity with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents a sponsorship tier with name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Represents a sponsorship node linking sponsor entity and tier.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the sponsorship graph with cursor and node.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainer
classes.description: Contains a list of sponsorship edges.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: Contains sponsorships as maintainer information for a user.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Wraps the user data in the GraphQL response.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: Top-level model for the GraphQL response data.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for tokens, repository info, and timeout.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Performs a GraphQL POST request to GitHub API and returns the response data.

methods.name: get_graphql_sponsor_edges
methods.description: Retrieves sponsor edges from GitHub GraphQL API.

methods.name: get_individual_sponsors
methods.description: Aggregates sponsors by tiers and returns a mapping of tier to sponsors.

methods.name: update_content
methods.description: Updates a YAML file with new content if it has changed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching sponsors, updating YAML, and creating a PR.
